trigger_observation.summary: First Windows smoke opened two Firefox windows and left focus on the blank one; Enter still minimized the ChatGPT worker, proving the Enter observer fired. Immediate rerun attempted to delete the checkout while WorkspaceOperator.exe was still executing from it, causing locked EXE/DLL removal failures; a later native-host launch also surfaced a .NET Desktop Runtime prompt.

repair_contract.handshake_gate: The dev smoke may print WORKSPACE_OPERATOR_SMOKE_READY only after a fresh browser_command_hub adapter_connected/APPLIED diagnostic from the newly launched Firefox runtime.
repair_contract.no_second_window_race: An early Ctrl+Space must not be invited while the adapter is disconnected; therefore the production fallback-launch race that created a second WorkspaceWorkers Firefox window is removed from the acceptance procedure.
repair_contract.restart_safe_binary: The dev helper must execute from a source-tree-keyed self-contained publish under LocalAppData, not from the Git checkout, so a running helper cannot lock checkout files during retry and Firefox native-host launch does not require machine-global .NET Desktop Runtime resolution.
repair_contract.smoke_ack_projection: After RecordLocalPrepared the content-free smoke reports Ready=0 and SentUnconfirmed=1. After human Enter, a subsequent Ctrl+Space must consume the local confirmation and report pending durable acknowledgment without refocusing Firefox.
repair_contract.authority_boundary: This repair changes only the development smoke/acceptance harness and local content-free status projection. It creates no live authority and does not weaken durable acknowledgment.
